questions.prompt: In optical fibers, what optical phenomenon guides light along the core without escaping into the cladding?
questions.explanation: When the angle of incidence in the core exceeds the critical angle relative to the lower-index cladding, total internal reflection traps the light wave.

questions.prompt: According to Heisenberg’s Uncertainty Principle, which pair of variables cannot be simultaneously measured with arbitrary precision?
questions.explanation: Delta x * Delta p >= h-bar / 2 establishes that position and linear momentum are canonically conjugate observables.
